app.title: RECOmuse
app.tagline: Your paper scores, as digital scores.

status.noBridge: Engine unavailable: the interface is open outside the RECOmuse window.

panels.scanEmpty: Import a PDF score or an image to get started.
panels.questionsEmpty: Open a score, or pick one from the list.

stage.recognition: Reading the score… This can take a minute or two per scanned page.

open.parts_other: {{count}} parts found in this file: pick one from the list.

questions.imageAlt: Excerpt of the score, with the doubtful spot circled
questions.grouped: Your answer will apply to all {{count}} places concerned.
questions.done: All questions have been answered. Thank you!
questions.unasked_one: {{count}} spot still needs checking by eye: this will be possible in the side-by-side view.
questions.unasked_other: {{count}} spots still need checking by eye: this will be possible in the side-by-side view.

text.clef_octave_suspicious: The clef was read with a small 8 (an "octave" clef). If that 8 is not there, all {{notes}} notes of the part are an octave too low. What do you see on the clef?
text.note_out_of_range_high: {{count}} notes seem too high for this instrument ({{notes}}…). Were they read an octave too high?
text.note_out_of_range_low: {{count}} notes seem too low for this instrument ({{notes}}…). Were they read an octave too low?
text.time_signature_missed: From here on, {{measures}} bars do not match the time signature. Does the time signature change to {{time}}?
text.time_signature_missing: No time signature was read at the start of the part. The bars seem to be in {{time}}. Is that the time signature?
text.multirest_missed: This rest was read as a single bar. Is it a {{count}}-bar rest?
text.multirest_missed_no_count: This rest was read as a single bar. Is it a rest of several bars?
text.multirest_count_unknown: The number of bars of this rest could not be read. How many bars does it last?
text.measure_number_mismatch: According to the printed bar numbers ({{printed_before}}, then {{printed_after}}), some bars are missing. Is this rest a {{count}}-bar rest?
text.part_measures_missing: The other parts of the piece have {{difference}} more bar(s) here. Is this rest a {{count}}-bar rest?
text.part_measures_extra: This part has {{difference}} more bar(s) than the other parts of the piece. Does this rest last {{count}} bars?
text.part_time_signature_differs: Here, {{agreeing_parts}} of the {{parts}} parts of the piece are in {{time}}. What about this one?

choices.time_unchanged: No, the time signature does not change
choices.rest_as_read_one: No, a single bar, as read

questions.compared_one: Compared with {{count}} other part of the piece.
questions.compared_other: Compared with the {{count}} other parts of the piece.

errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Try again; if it happens again, please report it.
errors.busy: A score is already being read.
errors.question_failed: This answer could not be saved.
errors.unsupported_format: This type of file is not supported (PDF or image only).
errors.unreadable_file: The file is damaged or unreadable.
errors.encrypted_pdf: This PDF is protected by a password.
errors.audiveris_not_found: Audiveris cannot be found: it must be installed to read scanned scores.
errors.tesseract_not_found: Tesseract cannot be found: texts cannot be read.
errors.audiveris_failed: Audiveris could not read this score.
errors.audiveris_timeout: Reading with Audiveris took too long.
